title: Normalize Facts
description: A deterministic fact normalizer for the audit-grade financial extraction suite.
Reads facts on the answers lane and cleans them with pure Python (no LLM):
it parses numbers and signs (parentheses, trailing/unicode minus, thousands separators),
detects and tags currency and scale (never converting, never multiplying the value),
maps free-text labels to standard metric names, and de-duplicates identical facts.</br>
The normalization is non-destructive: the raw label and value are kept, a
normalized block is added, and a provenance entry records how each
field was derived. Currency is tagged, not converted — conversion is the separate
currency_convert_explicit node. Records that are not fact objects pass through unchanged.

normalize_facts.label_field.title: Label field
normalize_facts.label_field.description: The fact field holding the free-text metric label (mapped to a standard metric name).

normalize_facts.value_field.title: Value field
normalize_facts.value_field.description: The fact field holding the raw numeric value to parse.

normalize_facts.default_currency.title: Default currency
normalize_facts.default_currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 code to tag when none is detected in the label or value (stored upper-case). Leave empty to keep facts untagged.

normalize_facts.decimal_format.title: Decimal format
normalize_facts.decimal_format.description: Number format. 'auto'/'us': comma = thousands separator, dot = decimal point. 'eu': dot = thousands separator, comma = decimal point.

normalize_facts.label_to_metric.title: Label→metric overrides
normalize_facts.label_to_metric.description: JSON map of {synonym: metric} merged over the built-in mapping (user entries win). Case-insensitive.
